title: WynnX
body:
# What is WynnX?
  
  A modpack focused on giving you the best experience on Wynncraft. As you would expect from Minecraft's biggest MMORPG the mods we use are constantly changing and we will do our best to keep everything up to date.

<details>
<summary>Performance & Graphics</summary>

**Cubes Without Borders:** Makes fullscreen borderless allowing for easy tabbing in/out

**Entity Culling:** Stops the rendering of entities hidden out of your view

**Ferrite Core:** Reduces RAM usage

**ImmediatelyFast:** Speeds up rendering of text and UI elements

**Iris Shaders:** Upgrades visuals with realistic lighting, shadows, and water graphics.

**Kenny's Epic Force Close Loading Screen:** Skips the loading terrain screen

**Lithium:** Game logic and physics optimization

**Particle Core:** Stops the rendering of particles hidden out of your view

**Shoulder Surfing Reloaded:** Better third person

**Sodium:** Rewrites minecraft's rendering engine

**Sodium Extra:** Adds extra video settings to Sodium
</details>
<details>
<summary>Quality of Life</summary>

**Controlling:** Search in keybinds menu
  
**Wynn Spell Caster:** Set keybinds for your spells (you will need to unbind wynntils' version)

**Wynntils:** The main Wynncraft mod

**WynnExtras:** Better bank, crafting helper, in game profile/guild viewer, raid list and more

**Wynnventory:** Adds useful tooltips to your HUD, displaying things like raid aspects and market prices
</details>

**WARNING: If a mod is removed for game breaking reasons you may need to re-download the modpack**
